--DROP TABLE IF EXISTS DBO.Velocedi_Error_Claims

--CREATE TABLE DBO.Velocedi_Error_Claims (ClaimID VARCHAR(20), ErrorNumber VARCHAR(20), ErrorDescription VARCHAR(4000), FileName837 varchar(1000), ConfigID varchar(30))

--Insert into ##Velocedi_Error_Claims1 select *  from  ##Velocedi_Error_Claims

TRUNCATE TABLE DBO.Velocedi_Error_Claims

DECLARE 
@Filename837 varchar(255),
@ConfigID Int

SET @Filename837 = @item.name

SELECT TOP 1 @ConfigID = ConfigId FROM DX_EDI.dbo.RunHistory WHERE ConfigID in (SELECT ConfigID from DX_EDI.dbo.EDIConfig WHERE ProcessName LIKE '%A2A%')
	  AND RunResult = 'Success' /*and CAST(RunDate AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) */ AND ActualFilenames like  '%'+@Filename837+'%' and Right(@Filename837,2) != 'BC'

SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL(@ConfigID,'') = '' THEN -1 ELSE @ConfigID END  as ConfigID

DELETE A2A 
FROM DBO.A2AMonthlyClaimsImport A2A
INNER JOIN DBO.Velocedi_Error_Claims ERR
	ON  A2A.CLCL_ID = ERR.ClaimID
		AND ErrorNumber in ( SELECT VALUE1 FROM DBO.EDI_A2A_SelectionCriteria WHERE CODETYPE = 'HIPAA_ERR_CODE' )
INNER JOIN EDIConfig C
	on ERR.ConfigID = C.Configid
	AND A2A.GRGR_CK = C.GRGR_CKs
	AND A2A.SOURCE_SYSTEM = CASE WHEN GRGR_CKs =89 THEN SUBSTRING(ProcessName,25,LEN(ProcessName) -29) ELSE SUBSTRING(ProcessName,24,LEN(ProcessName) -28) END
	AND A2A.CLAIM_TYPE = RIGHT(ProcessName,1)

UPDATE A2A SET FILENUMBER = ISNULL(FILENUMBER,0) + 1
FROM DBO.A2AMonthlyClaimsImport A2A
INNER JOIN DBO.Velocedi_Error_Claims ERR
	ON  A2A.CLCL_ID = ERR.ClaimID
		AND ErrorNumber in ('H10657') 
INNER JOIN EDIConfig C
	on ERR.ConfigID = C.Configid
	AND A2A.GRGR_CK = C.GRGR_CKs
	AND A2A.SOURCE_SYSTEM = CASE WHEN GRGR_CKs =89 THEN SUBSTRING(ProcessName,25,LEN(ProcessName) -29) ELSE SUBSTRING(ProcessName,24,LEN(ProcessName) -28) END
	AND A2A.CLAIM_TYPE = RIGHT(ProcessName,1)

DECLARE @FILE_CNT INT,  @CNT INT = 2, @CONFIGID INT, @SQL VARCHAR(MAX), @CHR_IND INT, @RERUN_FL VARCHAR(1) = '0', @WHERECLAUSE_CHK INT

SET @CONFIGID = @item.name

SELECT @FILE_CNT  = MAX(ISNULL(FILENUMBER,'0')) FROM DBO.A2AMonthlyClaimsImport A2A
INNER JOIN DBO.EDIConfig C
	on C.Configid = @CONFIGID
	AND A2A.GRGR_CK = C.GRGR_CKs
	AND A2A.SOURCE_SYSTEM = CASE WHEN GRGR_CKs =89 THEN SUBSTRING(ProcessName,25,LEN(ProcessName) -29) ELSE SUBSTRING(ProcessName,24,LEN(ProcessName) -28) END
	AND A2A.CLAIM_TYPE = RIGHT(ProcessName,1)

SELECT @CHR_IND = CHARINDEX('FILENUMBER = ',WHERECLAUSE) FROM  DBO.EDIConfig  WHERE ConfigID = @CONFIGID 
SELECT @WHERECLAUSE_CHK  = CAST(SUBSTRING(WHERECLAUSE, @CHR_IND+13,1) AS INT) FROM  DBO.EDIConfig  WHERE ConfigID = @CONFIGID 

IF @FILE_CNT  > 0 AND @FILE_CNT != @WHERECLAUSE_CHK
BEGIN
SET @FILE_CNT = @FILE_CNT - 1
	WHILE @CNT  > 0
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DBO.EDIConfig WHERE ConfigID = @CONFIGID AND RUNNOW = 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @CHR_IND = CHARINDEX('FILENUMBER = ',WHERECLAUSE) FROM  DBO.EDIConfig  WHERE ConfigID = @CONFIGID 
			SET @SQL  = 'UPDATE DBO.EDIConfig SET WHERECLAUSE = REPLACE(WHERECLAUSE,SUBSTRING(WHERECLAUSE,'+ CAST(@CHR_IND AS VARCHAR) +',14),''FILENUMBER = '+ CAST(@FILE_CNT AS VARCHAR) +'''), RUNNOW = 1 WHERE ConfigID = '+ CAST(@CONFIGID AS VARCHAR)
			EXEC (@SQL)
			SET @RERUN_FL = '1'
			WAITFOR DELAY '00:06'
			SET @FILE_CNT = @FILE_CNT + 1
			SET @CNT  = @CNT  - 1
		END
	END
END

ELSE
IF  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DBO.Velocedi_Error_Claims WHERE ConfigID = @CONFIGID AND ErrorNumber in ( SELECT VALUE1 FROM DBO.EDI_A2A_SelectionCriteria WHERE CODETYPE = 'HIPAA_ERR_CODE' ))
BEGIN
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DBO.EDIConfig WHERE ConfigID = @CONFIGID AND RUNNOW = 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @SQL  = 'UPDATE DBO.EDIConfig SET RUNNOW = 1 WHERE ConfigID = '+ CAST(@CONFIGID AS VARCHAR)
		EXEC (@SQL)
		SET @RERUN_FL = '1'
		WAITFOR DELAY '00:02'
	END
END


SELECT @RERUN_FL RERUN_FL
